Done. I placed all nine labels on the board photo. I zoomed in on the SATA ports label, which had been hidden behind another label, and it now sits on a SATA connector. The other eight I checked from the screenshots after dropping them. I left the CPU socket dot on the processor, since the chip sits in the socket.

- **Memory slots:** the DIMM slot rows at the top.
- **CPU socket:** the Ryzen chip in the middle.
- **24-pin ATX power:** the large connector at the top right.
- **CPU power headers:** the small 8-pin connector to the left of the CPU.
- **First PCIe slot:** the top x16 slot in the lower half of the board.
- **BMC chip:** the ASPEED chip at the lower left.
- **M.2 slots:** the slots at the right edge, above the SATA connectors.
- **USB 3.0 header:** the blue connector below the CPU.
- **SATA ports:** one of the SATA connectors at the right edge, below the M.2 slots.
